claims.quote: renewables in Israel rose from 6.1% to 16.9% of electricity in 2025
claims.sql: SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2020

claims.quote: renewables in Israel rose from 6.1% to 16.9% of electricity in 2025
claims.sql: SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025

claims.quote: an increase of about 11 percentage points
claims.sql: SELECT (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) - (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2020)
SELECT coal_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025

claims.quote: Generation grew by 2.8% per year on average between 2015 and 2025
claims.sql: SELECT 100.0 * (POWER((SELECT electricity_generation FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) / (SELECT electricity_generation FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015), 1.0 / 10.0) - 1)
SELECT electricity_generation FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025

claims.quote: Israel trails Greece (49.7%) on renewables in 2025

claims.quote: Israel trails Italy (48.8%) on renewables in 2025
claims.sql: SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Italy' AND year = 2025

claims.quote: Israel trails Greece (49.7%) and Italy (48.8%) on renewables in 2025
claims.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) < (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Greece' AND year = 2025) AND (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) < (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Italy' AND year = 2025) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
